name: Roseline
source:
Roseline is an ambitious fantasy visual novel, focused on cinematic storytelling set in a city removed from the rest of the world, where human emotion and spirit has the power to alter reality itself. Follow a narrative about love, grief and finding purpose, and uncover the mysteries that await.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2550990/Roseline/]Steam[/url]]
